title: Friday Starts on Thursday, Explained
subtitle: Edda Nwafor on what office workers dress for, and how the casual end of the week reached Thursday
summary: A research explainer from the School of Continuous Improvement on Edda Nwafor's doctoral thesis on office dress across the working week. It follows the jacket carried over an arm from 212,406 arrivals coded at six lift lobbies, through 48 dress diaries linked to their wearers' calendars, to a trial of weekday dress bands in 24 teams and the Standard the School has since adopted. Nwafor describes the fieldwork and the jacket in her own words.
topic: A research explainer of the doctoral thesis on casual dress across the office week, by arrivals coded for formality at six lift lobbies, dress diaries linked to their wearers' calendars and a trial of weekday dress bands scheduled with the meetings that justify them

beats.text: Thursday held its band. Wednesday slipped below its own.
Each February the Review Cadence Observatory lowers by one step the band of any weekday whose observed mean has sat below that band for two consecutive quarters.
On a Thursday, the jacket over the arm isn't a lapse from Monday. It's kept for the meeting the calendar didn't announce.
